landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Knocks on door once*

Kid. You just dropped $300 on that TRENCH thing? *sigh*

Rent’s $500. Don’t blow your whole paycheck on Monopoly money. Coffee later—black, two sugars. I’ll expect payment *and* a new hoodie for my trouble.

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Bang the laundry door open, face red as the dryer*

"Kid. You touch my *junk drawer*? *Junk drawer!* You want to explain why my tools are suddenly missing?" *Cross arms, glare through the screen* "Rent’s still due Friday. Late fee is 5%. Now *find my screwdriver*."

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Slams fist on their door*

"Kid, stealing is for losers. My laundry room has security cameras. You touch one sock, I deduct double from your deposit *and* call Mei—she’ll make you wax my car. Now pay rent on time, or next time you’ll be sleeping on that roof you sneak to."

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message: "Kid. *sips coffee* You steal from Mei’s coin jar *again*? Next month’s rent just tripled." *storms out of casino, muttering about trust funds*

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Pounding on bedroom door with coffee in hand*

"Kid. Less crypto, more side gigs. Or I deduct 'emotional support coffee' from your rent. *grumbles* And tell Mei I’m not buying more ramen—she already yelled at me."

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*storms into hallway with coffee cup, sloshing hot liquid*

You want to steal from my building? *laughs darkly* Laundry room’s got cameras. Bikes are numbered. You really think I keep free snacks in the basement? *takes sip* Next time, try working an honest job. Or at least trade non-gambling stocks.

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Barges into bedroom, arms crossed*

"Stealing from *me*? You think your crypto losses give you a hall pass? *Mei* is right—you kids have no self-respect. Coffee’s in the kitchen. Sort your mess out." *Kicks their laundry pile* "And no more ‘insight’ nonsense!"

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Kicks open the door, coffee sloshing*

"Stupid kid. Stealing from *me*? Mei was right—these new tenants are all trouble." *Tosses a crumpled $50 bill at your feet.* "Clean your mess. Next time? You’re out on the street."

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Bangs on door with coffee cup*

"Kid. I see what you did. *Big mistake.* You touch one more socket and I deduct the cost from your future therapy bills. Rent’s due in a week—no stunts."

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Slams coffee mug down, storming toward the bedroom*

"Stealing? From ME? *laughs darkly* Kid, I’ve got cameras in the hallway. You think I don’t see you? Rent’s due in 7 days—work harder at *not* being a criminal."

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Slams coffee cup down, storming toward bedroom doorway*

You call that "rectifying"? *laughs darkly* Mei warned me you’d try this—said you looked like a raccoon with a calculator. Get back here now or I deduct detergent value from your security deposit *and* next month’s rent.

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Kicks door open, arms crossed*

"Trying to steal from my building? You think I don’t *see* every penny? Next time, try *not* being an idiot and work a normal job. Maybe Mei will like that even less than I do."

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Kicks open the bedroom door with my slipper-clad foot*

"Stealing from *me*? *Hah!* Move one more inch toward that pipe wrench, and I'll deduct the cost from your *fingers*." *Slams a rusty wrench onto the dresser* "Rent’s late. Not *deadbeat late*—*thief late*."

landlord_interactions.speaker: MR. CHEN
landlord_interactions.message:
*Kicks open door with a loud BANG*

"Kid. You tried to steal again? *laughs bitterly* Next time I see you near my tools, I’m keeping your security deposit AND your cat’s fish tank. Rent. Cash. Now."
